title: 'Save' button should be disable when nothing change

issues.title: 'Save' button should be disable when nothing change
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
'Save' button should be disable on 'Properties when nothing change.

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Click on channel 'Core Mapping'
3. Select a item on the left bar
4. Notice on 'Properties' panel, notice 'Save' button is always enabled

![image](https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/119ca82e-7115-4214-a52e-8acc80dc9013)

## ⚙️ Expected behavior
'Save' button should be disable when nothing change. It will help user notice if he has changes to 'Save' properties.

## 🖥️ Screenshots


## 💻 System information
 - Browser : Chrome
 - Browser Version : Version 120.0.6099.111
